thresholds.accessibility: Zero critical/high accessibility defects; deterministic semantic reading order; headings, lists, links, tables, and status cues retain non-visual meaning.
thresholds.authored_content_preservation: 100% preservation unless a field is explicitly quarantined with before/after evidence and rollback metadata.
thresholds.build_formula: For each homogeneous unit family: max(15, ceil(unit_count / proven_batch_capacity)).
thresholds.capacity_rule: For each homogeneous unit family, proven_batch_capacity is the largest disjoint pilot batch completing the full gate within 60 minutes with zero hard-gate failures. Do not combine Paper and Task capacity.
thresholds.idempotence: Two consecutive reruns produce identical canonical semantic hashes and no additional mutations.
thresholds.pilot_failure_rate: Zero critical failures and at most 1% non-critical unit failures; any hard reader, preservation, schema, accessibility, idempotence, or rollback failure rejects the batch.
thresholds.reader_visibility: 100% of non-excluded fixtures render non-blank content or an explicit supported error on every target reader; zero silent blanks.
thresholds.render_test_gate: 100% of the declared candidate gate commands pass on every accepted pilot batch.
thresholds.rollback: 100% restoration from the recorded pre-image for every mutated scratch fixture; quarantine path tested for every rejected unit.
thresholds.schema_validity: 100% of candidate outputs pass the applicable PortableDoc/schema validators; zero malformed nodes introduced.
thresholds.structural_completeness: 100% of required authored semantic nodes and required Task contract fields survive the candidate transformation.
thresholds.surface_exercise: 100% of declared target surfaces must have real evidence; inaccessible Studio or email is BLOCKED, not N/A or PASS.
thresholds.width_overflow: No content loss or horizontal clipping at the narrowest supported TUI and email widths; long unbroken tokens degrade explicitly.
